description: Keep a multiline chat draft and its caret intact through ordinary Return, Shift Return, rotation and one Ctrl/Meta Return send per physical combination. Draft, caret and focus evidence come from the real-device input tests: the adaptive probe does not see the large-window composer's field, so this scene checks only that the process survives and the screenshots show the draft.

manualEvidence.mockSendCount: Read GET /mock/sent before and after each Ctrl/Meta Return; exactly one new session message is required. The existing runner does not query this endpoint.
manualEvidence.expandedEditor: Exercise Ctrl/Meta Return and Escape in LargeWindowComposerTest and ComposerHardwareTest; repeat on a hardware keyboard during integrated verification.
manualEvidence.ime: Use InputConnection.setComposingText or a real Chinese/Japanese IME; ASCII adb input text is not composition evidence.
manualEvidence.meta: If adb cannot inject META_LEFT, use instrumentation or a physical keyboard and record Meta as unverified until then.
